# `ui`

Mod UI on the client (IG-HUD, IG-ModUI): HUD widgets, toasts, notices and dialogs. Mods send data, the loader draws it with its own kit: mods cannot restyle it, place widgets freely or take focus away from the game. Needs no permission, and players can hide any mod's widgets. Server-side hosts and clients without a UI return `api-error::unsupported`. Added in 0.3. Dialog results arrive as a custom event named `<mod-id>:ui-action` (subscribe with `events.subscribe-custom`), delivered to the mod that opened the dialog only; the payload is a `types.value` map `{"dialog": u32, "button": u32, "text": string or null}` (`button` counts from 0, `null` text when the dialog has no field). Closing the dialog from the loader side (back, the game leaving the world) is `button` 4294967295.

Package `blockheads:api@0.3.1` · Lua table `bh.ui` · [WIT source](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/blob/dev/wit/blockheads-api/ui.wit)

Uses: `types.{api-error}`

## Types

### `slot` <Badge type="info" text="enum" />

Where a HUD widget goes. The loader stacks the widgets of a slot, keeps the game's own HUD and the screen cutout clear and hides what does not fit.

| Case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `top-left` | Under the game's HUD, top left. |
| `top-right` | Top right. |

### `widget-kind` <Badge type="info" text="enum" />

What a HUD widget looks like.

| Case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | One line of text (with an optional icon). |
| `counter` | An icon and a number: `text` holds the number. |
| `panel` | A small panel: `title` and up to four lines of `text` (split on newlines). |

### `widget` <Badge type="info" text="record" />

One HUD widget. Updating a widget with the same id replaces it.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `slot` |  |
| `kind` | `widget-kind` |  |
| `icon` | `option<string>` | A kit icon name: `coin`, `heart`, `info`, `warn`, `check`, `cross`, `bell` or `clock` (more are added over time). Unknown names draw no icon. |
| `title` | `option<string>` | The panel title (ignored by the other kinds). |
| `text` | `string` | The text, at most 256 bytes. |

### `notice-level` <Badge type="info" text="enum" />

How a notice looks.

| Case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `info` |  |
| `warning` |  |
| `success` |  |
| `error` |  |

### `button-kind` <Badge type="info" text="enum" />

## Functions

### `set-widget` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
set-widget: func(id: string, widget: widget) -> result<_, api-error>;
```

Shows or updates a widget. `id` is 1 to 32 characters of `a-z0-9_.-`, unique within the mod; a mod has up to 16 widgets.

### `remove-widget` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
remove-widget: func(id: string) -> bool;
```

Removes a widget. Returns false if it did not exist.

### `toast` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
toast: func(text: string) -> result<_, api-error>;
```

A short message that stacks bottom right (at most three visible, about four seconds each). `text` is at most 200 bytes.

### `notice` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
notice: func(text: string, level: notice-level) -> result<_, api-error>;
```

A notice in the top centre, one at a time (a new one replaces the last). `text` is at most 200 bytes.

### `show-dialog` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
show-dialog: func(dialog: dialog) -> result<u32, api-error>;
```

Opens a dialog (one at a time per mod) and returns its id. The answer comes as a `<mod-id>:ui-action` event.

### `close-dialog` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
close-dialog: func(id: u32) -> bool;
```

Closes a dialog of the mod without an answer. Returns false if it was not open.
